=== element stereotype twice
allowmixing
component "D3" <<s3>> as C3 <<s4>>
=== element tags twice
allowmixing
component C1 $a <<s>> $b
=== container stereotype twice
node "Display" <<s1>> as n1 <<s2>> {
}
node n2 <<s3>> as "Display" <<s4>> {
}
node d3 <<s5>> as n3 <<s6>> {
}
=== container tags twice
node n1 $a <<s>> $b {
}
=== parenthesis stereotype twice
() "D6" <<s>> as I6 <<t>>
() I7 <<a>> as "D7" <<b>>
() D8 <<c>> as I8 <<d>>
=== parenthesis two colors
() #red I4 #blue
() #green I5
=== note tags twice
class A
note right of A $t1 <<st>> $t2 : x
note left of A $t3 <<st>> $t4
  multi
end note
=== package tags twice
package p $a <<st>> $b {
}
=== multiline class tags twice
class A $a <<st>> $b {
}
=== tip tags twice
class A {
  f
}
note left of A::f $a <<st>> $b
  tip
end note
=== link styles twice
A -[#red]-[#blue]-> B
A -[dashed]-[bold]-> C
A -[#green]up-[dotted]-> D
=== map display
map "D" as m1 {
  a => b
}
=== object display
object "O" as o1
object o2 as "O2"
object "O3" as o3 {
}
